- **Long-term debt obligations** (payments due by period total): $22,372 million

  - Source: `documents/report.md`

To determine the percentage of total contractual obligations made up of long-term debt obligations:

\[
\text{Percentage} = \left( \frac{\text{Long-term debt obligations}}{\text{Total contractual obligations}} \right) \times 100
